name: Candyman
summary: Secret-role party game where a hidden Candyman winks to buy off Buyers before the hidden Cop can identify and bust him.
rules_text: From a deck take 1 Ace (Candyman), 1 King (Cop) and number cards equal to players-2. Shuffle and deal one face-down role card to each player. Candyman secretly winks at Buyers to sell; only Candyman may wink. A winked Buyer must reveal his number card, announce Sold, and is out, without revealing Candyman. Cop may at any time accuse one player by saying Busted and pointing. Accused reveals card: if Candyman, round ends; if Buyer, Buyer scores and leaves and round continues with Cop now known. Scoring per round: Candyman +1 per sale, -2 if busted; Buyer +1 if buys or is falsely accused; Cop -1 per false accusation, +2 for correct bust. Play 15 rounds or until 21 points.
rating_reason: Secret role game with Ace/King assignment, bluffing and allies
